matching_rules: A vulnerable case is a TP when exactly one finding has rule==expected.rule on the manifest file (extension-stripped; route files are matched by their full relative path) and an exact absolute line match, with severity at or above severity_floor.

Multiple findings for one underlying defect collapse to the primary expected rule; secondary findings (advisory notes such as RES-003, or additional true rules on the same vulnerable file, e.g. AUTHZ-001 next to TEN-002) are neither TP/FN nor FP and are excluded from precision arithmetic.

Safe cases expect ZERO findings above LOW severity; a finding above LOW on a safe file counts as a false positive. LOW-severity review notes are advisory (no score) and are only tolerated on a safe case when the manifest lists them under allowed — otherwise they count as FP.
Line numbers are exact-absolute by contract (deterministic scanner); a finding on the wrong line counts as FN, not TP.
